messages:
Anna K: Quick idea — introduce an `x-rw-intent` header (or `x-rw-intent-v1`) to carry high-level intent like `summarize`, `embed`, `chat`, `rerank`. Use cases: routing to cheaper model variants, console per-intent dashboards, and quota attribution. Thoughts?
Ben L: sgtm in principle. main question: do SDKs auto-set it or require explicit param? auto behavior could break cost expectations.
Michael R: prefer explicit opt-in param in SDKs. implicit derivation seems risky (esp for wrappers). Also need clear behavior for batching — mixed intents in a single batch is a headache.
Sara P: console side +1. If we get intent, we can surface dedicated tiles and map to route groups. Also helps quality alerts by intent. Need stable enum and docs.
Anna K: proposed SDK changes: add optional `intent` arg to client calls (py/ts/go). default `None` means no header. also add global flag `enable_intent_auto` default false so teams can opt into auto-derivation later. validation on SDK to only accept known enum.
Ben L: cache + batching concerns: KV/prefix caching must include intent in cache key or else we risk cold/poisoned cache across intents. Also batching proxy will need to not coalesce different intents.
Michael R: server-side choices: 1) accept header and honor in routing; 2) if mixed-intent batch arrives, return 400; 3) or server can split but that complicates accounting. I lean to rejecting mixed batches so clients are forced to split.
Sara P: migration/console UX: we should warn in the console if a route expected intents but request arrives without one. Add a small migration wizard mapping intents -> dashboard routes.
Anna K: sample SDK snippets (draft):
```python
# python
resp = client.generate("Summarize...", intent="summarize")
```
```ts
// ts
client.generate({prompt: '...', intent: 'summarize'})
```
```go
// go
req.Intent = "summarize"
```
Ben L: edge-case: streaming + incremental prompts — intent should be set on initial request only. Also ensure batching layer preserves header per-request when multiplexing.
Michael R: header naming/casing: normalize to lowercase `x-rw-intent`. SDKs must set lowercased header so proxies don't treat casing as different.
Anna K: rollout plan idea: phase 1 = SDK opt-in + routing-proto v2 accepts header (canary). phase 2 = 2 weeks telemetry + console tiles. phase 3 = opt-in-by-default in SDK minor bump, with migration docs.
Sara P: add mapping table to docs: intent -> suggested route, quota bucket, dashboard tile name. We'll need product sign-off.
Ben L: tests to add: python/ts/go e2e showing split-by-intent batching, caching key includes intent, and proxy passthrough test. Add unit tests for unknown-intent validation.
infra-bot: deploy-bot scheduled a canary for `routing-proto-v2` tomorrow 03:00 UTC — will accept `x-rw-intent-v1` in permissive mode.
deploy-bot: Note: when in permissive mode unknown intents are logged, strict mode will 400.
Michael R: one more: clients should gracefully degrade — if server responds 400 for mixed-intent, SDK should automatically retry by splitting the batch (if it can) to avoid developer panic.
Anna K: agree. add fallback logic in SDKs: try single-request header, on 400 split and retry per-intent, and emit telemetry metric `sdk.intent.split_retry`.
Sara P: doc ask: changelog entry + console migration guide + example mapping file. I'll draft the console side.
Ben L: I'll review API PRs — include changelog and test plan.
Anna K: tagging @Ben L @Michael R for API/infra review. I'll open draft PRs for python/ts/go later today.
Ben L: :thumbsup:
Anna K: thanks — will follow up with a short RFC/PR.
